verdict.rationale: Speechmatics' own docs state that you can 'integrate Speechmatics quickly with SDKs for your language,' which confirms official SDKs exist. That is a single landing-page line, with no detail on which languages, what the SDKs cover, or how they are maintained. Missing for 10: list of supported SDK languages, SDK reference docs or repositories, coverage of realtime/batch/TTS/agent APIs in the SDKs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
